user.title: Connect to ShowPilot
user.description: Address of your ShowPilot server, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3100. The show token is optional: without it you get now playing, queue, viewers and tonight's numbers; with it you can also change the viewer mode, categories and viewer page, clear the queue, and see whether FPP is connected. Copy it from ShowPilot admin → Plugin → Show Token.

reauth_confirm.title: ShowPilot show token changed
reauth_confirm.description: ShowPilot at {url} refused the show token. Paste the current one from ShowPilot admin → Plugin → Show Token, or leave it empty to keep only the read-only entities.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the server at that address.
error.not_showpilot: That address answered, but it isn't a ShowPilot server.

abort.already_configured: This ShowPilot server is already set up.
abort.different_server: That's a different server; add it as a new integration instead.
